The game text is short and sweet. Fire a blaster, or artillery weapon, or a starship cannon, or [[Proton Torpedoes]], or *any* weapon (except a lightsaber) and the Light Side gets an extra battle destiny. Doesn't matter if you can't hit the side of a barn, that extra destiny is going to hurt. [[Slight Weapons Malfunction]] is a Used Interrupt, with its own destiny of 4. The best part is a destiny adder card that does not require the presence of [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]], [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]], Ben, and [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] . . . just any warrior or pilot with a trigger finger or other suitable digit.

Combos:

starfighter or vehicle + [[Rapid Fire]] + [[Slight Weapons Malfunction]]. Set up a neat trap with a lonely decoy X-Wing or Speeder. [[Rapid Fire]] to deploy a weapon for free from hand OR Reserve, then SWM to finish off with an unexpected battle destiny.
|combos=* Starfighter or Vehicle + [[Rapid Fire]] + [[Slight Weapons Malfunction]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Slight%20Weapons%20Malfunction</ref>
